pages.title: Air Separation Unit
pages.text: Air compressed, cooled until it liquefies, and boiled apart: nitrogen off the top, oxygen from the bottom.$(br2)$(thing)Tier 1$() machine.
$(thing)Made on the Extreme Assembly Table$() (it is also a crafting table). The recipe pages at the end of this entry - and JEI - show the pattern.
Separates the air into nitrogen and oxygen. Needs nothing but power.
$(thing)Machine data$(): a single-block machine (4 item and 1 fluid inputs, 1 and 2 outputs).$(br2)$(thing)Makes$(): Nitrogen, Oxygen.
